product.glassAndResin: Hybrid Carbon HolySheet Bi/Bi; Magic Bean Resin
manufacturerClaims: Hybrid HolySheet interwoven with Carbon Boosters for precise, lightweight construction
Resort V1 combines traditional camber, zero camber and reverse camber zones for pop, response and predictable turn initiation

review.targetSeasonTest: 2026 model, size 154 cm, one demo day at Stratton VT on 2025-02-04; reviewer reports 142 lb rider weight. Reviewer separately has 250+ accumulated days across multiple seasons and says versions after 2024 feel similar, with slightly more pressable tips. Do not attribute all accumulated experience to the one-day 2026 sample.
review.sampleVsSeed: Season/model matches the 25/26 seed, but test size 154 differs from the official-table median seed size 156; this is directional evidence, not a representative-size retest.

observations.stability: Review describes the board as stable at high speed, but nose/tail chatter is felt on uneven terrain; reviewer considers the chatter manageable and says damp bindings can mask it.
observations.response: Strong carving response and edge hold are described; external responsiveness subscore is 10/10, not directly mapped to our rubric.
observations.float: Reviewer says it does not float well in deep powder; centered true-twin configuration is not a powder specialty.
observations.park: Strong spring-like pop and jump performance; reviewer emphasizes jumps and small/medium park features, with useful switch/jib capability.
observations.forgiveness: Board is pressable but contact points may feel catchy; the reviewer warns inexperienced riders can catch an edge and places the board at intermediate level.
observations.externalScoreScope: These are the review page's aggregate/current review scores, not a scoring record isolated to the one-day 2026 demo sample.

editorialDecision.rationale: Stability rises modestly from 6.5 to 7 because the target-year review describes high-speed composure, bounded by noticeable but manageable chatter on uneven snow. Forgiveness falls modestly from 7.5 to 7 because the reviewer identifies catchy contact points and explicitly cautions beginner riders. These are directional editorial adjustments based on one target-year demo sample (154 cm, not the 156 cm seed size); external scores are not numerically converted. Response/float/park remain consistent with the review but have limited sample coverage. Value remains unchanged and low-confidence because the CNY seed price has no verified China-market source.
editorialDecision.confidence: Low-to-medium overall; one target-year demo day by an experienced reviewer plus multiyear related-model background, with a different sample size. Value confidence is low.
